quests.title: Corps of Thirty Recruitment

dialogue.t: Greetings, welcome to the Citadel of Regzar.
This is where the Corps of Thirty get in touch with each other and coordinate. I can see from your outfit that you are not one of them...
Oh, I see, you came for the recruitment, right?
Very well then. I'll brief you on the gig in case it's not clear.
I am Effendi, a liaison sent by the Akademiya to coordinate the cooperation between the Akademiya and the Corps of Thirty.
You may have known that the Corps of Thirty is hired by the Akademiya to guard the whole Sumeru City.
They are additionally responsible for dealing with some problems residents encounter in daily life, which compounds their workload.
To ease the pressure, I decided to recruit an assistant after consulting with the Parchamdar.
You don't need to worry about city defense, just help us complete the residents' commissions.
As to the specifics, most of them are cumbersome and detailed. I'll elaborate with examples.
That's the commission in general. It'd be great if you're willing and free to take it.
The logistics officer and I have agreed that you will be paid fairly for every gig you do.
Trivial as these commissions may be, I do hope you recognize the importance of this job.
You will be appreciated and respected by all who you have helped with their life.
If you stick to it, you'll surely heighten your Reputation among the residents, and they'll be more willing to accept you.
And I'll offer you more important and complicated jobs by then.
That's the general picture of this job. I hope you can think it over.
If you decide to take the job, feel free to register for the commissions.

quests.description: The Corps of Thirty is hiring an assistant. Interested candidates, kindly contact Effendi at the Citadel of Regzar.
